Excellent dinner for my birthday!
Aug 2026 • Couples
Classy atmosphere, elegant but without being overly formal, with a beautiful open kitchen that helps make the experience even more interesting.

The menu offers Vietnamese cuisine reinterpreted in a modern and elegant way. The portions are well-balanced and allow you to order several dishes and build a real tasting menu.

Among the tastings, we were particularly surprised by the Smoked Eel Sausage, an eel sausage with a truly unexpected and original flavor. The Pho Essence Tartare was also very interesting, especially for its lightness and delicacy. The main courses were also excellent, in particular the Wok Fried and the duck, both truly top-notch.

The service was always attentive and thoughtful. It was my birthday and at the end of the dinner they even offered us a dessert complete with birthday wishes, even though we had already ordered and eaten one! 😄 A gesture that was very much appreciated nonetheless.

We spent about 70€ per person, a certainly significant amount for Hanoi but, considering the quality of the cuisine, the atmosphere, and the service, absolutely justified.

A dinner that did not betray expectations and that remains among the best gastronomic experiences of our trip. Absolutely recommended.

Dear Ms.Diep,

We would like to extend our most sincere apologies for the less-than-perfect experience you had during your dinner at Vien Dining on May 31st.

We are truly sorry and fully understand your disappointment, especially when the flow of your meal was affected by a significant delay in service. Although our team made every effort to remedy the situation during the evening, we recognize that these issues negatively impacted your overall experience.

In response to your feedback regarding the long wait between courses, we would like to offer a bit of context. While you were dining, our kitchen was also simultaneously preparing a 12-guest tasting menu on the upper floor. This pre-ordered menu follows a pre-set timeline and sequence, allowing the kitchen to prepare and serve in a streamlined fashion. In contrast, your à la carte order required individual preparation in real-time, which inherently involves more flexibility and potential variability in timing.

We fully understand the frustration of seeing another table served more quickly, even if they arrived later. This discrepancy in service pace is something we take full responsibility for. Rather than using the circumstances as justification, we view this as a shortcoming in our operational execution—one we must address seriously to ensure consistent and thoughtful experiences for all our guests.

At Vien Dining, we strive to create refined and attentive dining moments, and we are deeply sorry that we failed to meet your expectations—especially given the trust and anticipation you had when choosing our restaurant.

Your feedback has been escalated to our operations team for thorough review and immediate improvements. This has been an important and humbling lesson that we do not take lightly.

If you would allow us the opportunity, we would be honored to welcome you back in the near future—so we may personally extend our apologies and serve you with the care and quality that truly reflect Vien’s values.

With sincere gratitude for your honest and valuable feedback,
Vien Dining Team

Must-try Viet dining
May 2024 • Business
Personally, since I've become acquainted with and explored fine dining experiences, I mostly tried French cuisine, so I have limited experience with Viet fusion, and all my assessments are based on personal feelings!

My table was nicely dressed up with fresh flowers, which was really impressive, making it perfect for Instagram-worthy moments. 

The standout dish for me from the set menu was the Frog dish, giving a sensory explosion because it combines multiple layers of flavors, especially paired with betel leaves. The next impressions were the tuna rice, slightly smoked rice underneath, the duck steamed-rice pancake and local snail. I was quite impressed with the sauce, my taste leans towards rich flavors. 

The pairing was mostly suitable with my non-alcoholic drinks, slightly more impressive was the pandan-infused tamarind drink.

The menu "The Street Wander" was very intriguing, and there were food cards that tell different stories and inspiration behind each dish. 

The serving time was a bit long, but not making us get to the point of impatience, possibly due to the crowd, which is understandable. Otherwise the staffs were ery friendly and helpful.

A brief inquiry into Hanoian cuisine. Good food & service.
May 2024 • Solo
I was introduced to this place by a local friend who worked in the industry here in Hanoi. Vien was then serving a tasting emnu called "The Street Wander" with a set of local-food-inspired innovative cuisines, which literally gave me so many insights into Hanoian cuisine. As the staffs introduced, their food were designed upon the inspiration from many famous Vietnamese food that you might have missed, such as Frog Hotpot, Local Sausage, Local Snail, etc. My top-pick is the Frog-twist with crispy texture and umami flavors, which intertwined nicely with their homemade liquors.

This dining space is small but delicate enough, bringing up a comforatble sense of coziness. When I went there, it was quite crowded, so I had to wait a bit longer for the food, but the staff were extremely nice, always checking on me and my pals with loads of interesting stories into their food and Vietnamese culture. 

Cannot wait to try their next tasting menu next time I come back.
